narr: Scattered thunderstorms impacted Middle Tennessee on June 3, 2024. The strongest thunderstorm impacted the Nashville area where numerous trees fell, and flash flooding occurred in the Inglewood neighborhood.
ev: Heavy rain caused flooding in the Inglewood area of east Nashville with water inundating yards and up to the foundation of some homes on Ardee Avenue and Riverwood Drive. Damages are a rough estimate.
lsr: Water inundating yards and up to the foundation of some houses on Ardee Ave and Riverwood Drive in Inglewood.
